annotation.summary: 本章以武曲财星、将星及阴金性质解释其作用，回顾传统女命寡宿与武贪、武杀、武破的负面评价。作者强调财与囚仇须结合吉化与行限，不能一概论凶，并将以理论命盘及实例讨论铃昌陀武、因财持刀、武贪不发少年人等。
annotation.summary_en: This chapter frames Wu Qu as a wealth and martial star of yin metal. It previews traditional female-marriage interpretations and Wu Qu combinations with Tan Lang, Qi Sha and Po Jun, without endorsing uniformly negative conclusions. Cai Yu Qiu Chou depends on benefic transformations and fortune periods. The chapter also introduces Ling Chang Tuo Wu, Yin Cai Chi Dao and Wu Tan Bu Fa Shao Nian Ren through theoretical charts and cases.
keywords_en: Wu Tan Bu Fa Shao Nian Ren

annotation.summary: 武曲为阴金财星，论财不能只看财帛宫，还须兼看命宫武曲，并联系福德、田宅。武曲会禄存并非必然巨富：旺宫且多吉才可强论；陷宫多吉少煞仍辛苦得财，化忌或多煞少吉则反不利财。
annotation.summary_en: Wu Qu is described as yin metal and a wealth star. Financial interpretation must consider Wu Qu in the Life Palace together with the Wealth, Happiness and Property Palaces. Sharing a wealth palace with Lu Cun does not guarantee great riches: strength and many benefics are required. In a weak palace, many benefics and few malefics can still mean hard-earned money; Hua Ji or many malefics with few benefics can instead harm finances.

annotation.summary: 作者以金性内聚、刚硬解释武曲的刚毅称谓，认为武曲坐命者通常性格刚直、言行直接，并以战将须刚强勇猛的类比说明其将星之名。
annotation.summary_en: The author links Wu Qu’s traditional yin-metal symbolism of inward cohesion and hardness to its resolute designation. Wu Qu in the Life Palace is generally described as forthright and direct. The martial-star name is explained through an analogy with a strong, courageous battlefield commander.

annotation.summary: 将星得地不能只凭武曲坐命，须旺宫且会多吉。单星名义旺弱仍须三方四正吉煞合论。武相寅旺申平，武破巳旺亥陷；武破在亥即使多吉能显正面作用，强度仍逊巳宫且较辛劳。
annotation.summary_en: Jiang Xing De Di requires more than Wu Qu in the Life Palace: a strong palace and many benefics are necessary. Nominal strength must be reassessed through benefics and malefics in the three directions and four cardinal palaces. Wu Qu with Tian Xiang is strong in Yin and neutral in Shen; with Po Jun it is strong in Si and weak in Hai. Even with benefics, the Hai combination remains weaker and more laborious than Si.
